Proposition
[connection laws of the normal connection]

↗ def:dc-ch6-3-normal-connection ↗ lem:dc-ch6-2-proj

The normal connection has the usual properties of a connection: it is additive in both arguments, $\mathcal{D}$-homogeneous in the direction ($ abla ^\perp _{fX}\eta =f abla ^\perp _X\eta $), and satisfies the Leibniz rule $ abla ^\perp _X(f\eta )=f abla ^\perp _X\eta +X(f)\, \eta $ for $\eta $ normal.
Proof

\sketch Immediate from the corresponding laws of $\overline{ abla }$ and the additivity and $\mathcal{D}$-homogeneity of the normal projection (section 1); in the Leibniz rule the first-order term $X(f)\, \eta $ is already normal because $\eta $ is.

□
